title: File transfer
idea: File transfer: A queue separates waiting active failed and verified transfers
audience: People who need to transfer file within a desktop surface.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic transaction layout through its transfer file priority and explicit commitment contract: Completion requires verified destination acknowledgement
navigation: File transfer keeps the current transfer file context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: A queue separates waiting active failed and verified transfers
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to transfer file; file operations need resumable progress

imagery.role: Support the actual transfer file context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Keep source destination and retry details in focused rows
Respect window resizing, keyboard navigation and persistent document/workspace context.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the file transfer structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no transfer file content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Completion requires verified destination acknowledgement
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized transfer file content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active transfer file context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure representative large documents/collections and resize interaction on target OS.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate with browser study renders. Automated browser checks are recorded in evals/specimen-review.json. No independent visual comparison, task study or native runtime verification; remains draft. The illustration/task content demonstrates composition and does not prescribe every linked palette or font.
